html:
G'oya

Bu ikki to'plamning simmetrik farqi: Chilonzorda bor, Yunusobodda yo'q mahsulotlar va aksincha. Har bir yo'nalish alohida EXCEPT, keyin ikkala natija bitta ro'yxatga qo'shiladi. Yorliq ('Chilonzor', 'Yunusobod') EXCEPT bajarilib bo'lgandan keyin qo'yiladi.

Yechim

SELECT product, 'Chilonzor' AS store
FROM (SELECT product FROM chilonzor_stock
      EXCEPT
      SELECT product FROM yunusobod_stock) c
UNION ALL
SELECT product, 'Yunusobod'
FROM (SELECT product FROM yunusobod_stock
      EXCEPT
      SELECT product FROM chilonzor_stock) y

EXCEPT takrorlarni o'zi olib tashlaydi, shuning uchun ikki partiya bo'lib kelgan Non bir marta chiqadi. Ikki qism hech qachon bir xil qator bermaydi (yorliqlari har xil), shuning uchun oxirida UNION ALL yetarli.

Tuzoqlar

Yorliqni EXCEPTdan oldin qo'shsangiz, solishtirish buziladi: ('Sut', 'Chilonzor') va ('Sut', 'Yunusobod') har xil qatorlar, ular bir-birini hech qachon ayirmaydi. To'plam amallari qatorni butunligicha solishtiradi.

Noto'g'riSELECT product, 'Chilonzor' AS store FROM chilonzor_stock
EXCEPT
SELECT product, 'Yunusobod' FROM yunusobod_stock
UNION
SELECT product, 'Yunusobod' FROM yunusobod_stock
EXCEPT
SELECT product, 'Chilonzor' FROM chilonzor_stock

NOT IN yoki NOT EXISTS bilan yozilsa, DISTINCT esdan chiqadi va bir necha partiyali mahsulot bir necha marta chiqadi.

Boshqa yo'l

NOT EXISTS bilan ham bo'ladi, faqat takrorlarni o'zingiz olib tashlaysiz:

SELECT DISTINCT product, 'Chilonzor' AS store FROM chilonzor_stock c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM yunusobod_stock y WHERE y.product = c.product)
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT product, 'Yunusobod' FROM yunusobod_stock y
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chilonzor_stock c WHERE c.product = y.product)
